newsitem.title: SPAIN: Rato says Spain's chances for EMU launch very good.
newsitem.headline: Rato says Spain's chances for EMU launch very good.

text.p: Spanish Economy Minister Rodrigo Rato said on Thursday that Spain has a very good chance of joining the launch of Europe's single currency.

"At the moment, the chances that Spain is among the countries that form the future united Europe are very good and international markets recognise that," Rato told journalists at the close of a seminar in Madrid.
Rato, referring to the Bank of Spain's quarter-point interest rate cut, said "(It) is very good news for families."

The Bank of Spain's decision to cut rates rested on the decline in inflation, Rato said, but added that renewed efforts needed to be made on the price front "since Spain has a rate of 3.2 pct and France of 1.7 pct."
